output.reason: The evidence states that penal charges for non-compliance shall be treated as ‘penal charges’ and shall not be levied as ‘penal interest’ added to the loan’s interest rate. It also provides that such penal charges shall be reasonable and levied by lenders only on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner as per the lender’s Board-approved policy. Finally, it says additional/fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges. This matches the claim’s conditions: reasonable, non-discriminatory under Board-approved policy; not as penal interest; and not as additional charges on earlier penal charges.
